morgan: Heads-up — intermittent mkdocs build failure on main CI. Seems tied to anchor resolution when headings include trailing emojis or inline HTML blocks. Failing job: https://circleci.com/gh/redwood/docs/12345 ashley: Can you paste the snippet + exact error from the logs? I can take a look. morgan: Yep. File: docs/guides/deploy.md. Repro pattern: a heading like `## Quick start 🚀` followed immediately by an HTML table and then a code block. CI log shows: ``` ERROR: Could not resolve fragment 'quick-start' in page 'deploy.md' File ".../site/deploy.html", line 1, in mkdocs.exceptions.ConfigurationError: Fragment 'quick-start' referenced but no matching anchor found ``` sam: I saw a similar one when a heading ended with a colon (`## Options:`). Different slugify libs handle punctuation/emoji differently, so slugs diverge across envs. yu: Options: (A) require explicit anchors where it matters: `## Quick start {#quick-start}` (attr_list extension), (B) run a docs-lint transform that normalizes headings (strip emojis/punct) and inserts `{#...}` suggestions, or (C) pin the markdown/slugify packages in pyproject to freeze behavior. ashley: Attr_list isn't enabled in mkdocs.yml now — enabling might change many pages. Linter + suggestions seems safest. Can we add a script that flags ambiguous headings and offers the explicit id as an auto-fix? morgan: I'll prototype a small script to scan for headings with trailing punctuation/emojis and either insert `{#id}` or emit a lint error. Heuristic: lowercase, spaces → `-`, remove punctuation except hyphen. sam: Also add a pre-commit regex to catch heading followed immediately by an HTML block. Regex suggestion: `(?m)^#{1,6} .*\n<\w` — warn when matched. That pattern seems to trigger the parser quirk. ashley: Paste the offending markdown slice? morgan: Sure: ```markdown ## Quick start 🚀
Example
```bash echo "deploy" ``` ``` yu: Another mitigation: detect unresolved fragment errors in the build step and temporarily demote them to warnings while we fix docs, to avoid blocking PRs. Then re-enable as failures after cleanup. morgan: Opening a small PR with two parts: (1) docs-lint script to flag/auto-fix ambiguous headings, (2) CI tweak to pin mkdocs-mdx/slugify versions for stability. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4567 ci-bot: Build retriggered for morgan/patch-quickstart — CircleCI job 67890 queued :white_check_mark: ashley: Thanks. Include a clear PR description explaining the heuristic and why we pinned deps. Add a unit test in docs-lint with emoji/colon headings to prevent regressions. sam: I'll add the pre-commit hook and a small unit test for the heading+HTML detection. morgan: PR opened, added changelog + tests, tagging @ashley @yu for review. Low-risk Markdown-only change. Thx :pray:
